name: Delete an ASN
description: Delete an ASN Delete an ASN from botnet threat feed for a given user. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/botnet_feed/configs/asn/{asn_id}

name: Get daily report
description: Get daily report Gets all the data the botnet tracking database has for a given ASN registered to user account for given date. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/botnet_feed/asn/{asn_id}/day_report
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/botnet_feed/asn/{asn_id}/day_report
Gets all the data the botnet tracking database has for a given ASN registered to user account for given date. If no date is given, it will return results for the previous day.
Required: account_id (path); asn_id (path)
Optional: date (query)

name: Get full report
description: Get full report Gets all the data the botnet threat feed tracking database has for a given ASN registered to user account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/botnet_feed/asn/{asn_id}/full_report
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/botnet_feed/asn/{asn_id}/full_report
Gets all the data the botnet threat feed tracking database has for a given ASN registered to user account.
Required: account_id (path); asn_id (path)

name: Get list of ASNs
description: Get list of ASNs Gets a list of all ASNs registered for a user for the DDoS Botnet Feed API. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/botnet_feed/configs/asn
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/botnet_feed/configs/asn
Gets a list of all ASNs registered for a user for the DDoS Botnet Feed API.
Required: account_id (path)
